notes.title: Important News!
notes.content:
Hi, Ells&Pills is here!
It’s time for another round of discounts, but that’s not the main thing.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45051997/bcbceb81268cb7cd25a0547b86c270bdaa4d14bb.jpg[/img]

Today, we want to share with you information about an interesting indie horror game being created by our friend from Ukraine. This is his debut game — he’s working on it solo under very difficult life circumstances. So, we would really appreciate it if you could visit the game’s Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405860/Lurking_Within/

If the game catches your attention, please add it to your Wishlist! Today, this means a lot and is especially valuable for the creator.

Best Regards, 
Ells&Pills.

notes.title: Announcement of the new Ells Tales!
notes.content:
Hi there!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45051997/542b037f5404605d6f024452d372fa616baa745d.jpg[/img]

After almost a year, we’re excited to announce the upcoming release of the new game [b]Ells Tales[/b], returning to the roots of the series! Missing the separate control of each of the character’s hands and that retro-style graphics?

So, we’re proud to present the new chapter — [b]Ells Tales: Chairbound[/b]. Step into the shoes of a person tied to an office chair in the middle of a gloomy office building. Control the movement and rotation of the chair using physics, but be careful not to tip over, and find your way to escape before time runs out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-wZ11Xy7Zhc

Add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss the upcoming release:

store.steampowered.com/app/3281410/Ells_Tales_Chairbound

Wishing you a great summer! All the best from the Ells&Pills team!

notes.title: It's discount time!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021997/cbc707ad1e52d0d1126f51bd864e63a72736bd4e.jpg[/img]

Hi, Ells&Pills is here!

We've been really looking forward to this moment! Today we released our second game, so there's an opportunity to make [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43019/Ells_Tales/]a bundle of games with a permanent 10% discount[/url]. In addition, both games are individually discounted 10% for two weeks.

We don't know how successful the second game was, but the final third game about the world of humanoid chickens will be closer exactly to Ells Tales: Egg. It will once again be a first-person game.

We also want to share that in exactly one week our third game will be released. It will also be a puzzle horror game like Ells Tales, but in a different visual style and a different environment. Check out this game and add it to your wishlist if you like it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2785980/

Thank you all for your support, stay tuned! Lots of fun ahead! ^_^

notes.title: The sequel announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021997/6992751d4bc6ae3462ccfbf1f94a3c28007cdd82.jpg[/img]
Hi there!

When we came up with the idea for this game, we didn't expect at all that it would turn out to be a really fun game and that people would like it for its theme. Today we published the page of the next game, it's a direct continuation of the game. The events of the game will happen after the canonical ending (END#2).

Like the first game, the next game is also a bit of an odd mix of genres. We have no idea if people will enjoy the game just as much, but if you have nothing against sokoban and chickens, then add the game to your wishlist! This will really help us to understand the interest in the game and make further plans for the development of the game series.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066660/Ells_Tales_Chicken/

We've also created a creator page to make it easy to see all the games in one place. So you can subscribe to it, so you won't miss anything new later in the endless stream of information:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ellsandpills


We wish you a nice summer! All the best from the Ells&Pills team!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021997/1a4788686786d96c74ca0314771b27913e990800.jpg[/img]
Hi there!
We are very happy about the warm reception of our first game, especially among players from Asian countries! Thank you so much for inspiring us to do new things! <3
We will be announcing a sequel to this game soon. This is going to be another fun mix of genres with horror. So stay tuned, we'll see you soon! ^_^

All the best from the Ells&Pills team!
